summary: JUNE 2026 iteration 5 re-verification. Both P0 regressions from iter_4 are NOW FIXED and verified. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_statement_decoder_quota.py → 6/6 PASS (was 4/6 in iter_4). The crucial TestFreeTierQuota::test_first_upload_succeeds_second_returns_402 case PASSES — second /api/statements/upload-text call on a free-plan user now correctly returns 402 + {detail:{error:'free_tier_exhausted', message:'You\'ve used your free decode...', retry_at_unix:int, redirect:'/pricing'}} + Retry-After header. test_upload_endpoint_also_gated also PASSES, confirming the multipart /statements/upload path remains gated. FRONTEND: /settings/appearance text-size pills work on web preview. Empirical results (viewport 390x844, demo user logged in via cathy@example.com prod JWT, then nav to /settings/appearance): (1) Active-pill flip works — borderColor on tapped pill switches to rgb(14,77,82) (brand) and previously-active pill returns to rgba(14,77,82,0.12) within ~400ms of tap. Confirmed for XL→SM→MD cycle. (2) Visual scaling works — heading 'Text size' bounding-box height: baseline 17px → XL 22.09px (×1.30) → SM 15.30px (×0.90), exactly matching TEXT_SCALES table {sm:0.9, md:1.0, lg:1.15, xl:1.3}. Pill heights and content-row heights scale by the same factor. (3) Navigation preserved — location.pathname stays '/settings/appearance' through all pill taps; no bounce to /today or /login. (4) zoom cleared when Default selected — document.documentElement.style.zoom === '' after tapping md (Default). IMPLEMENTATION NOTE: when XL is active, zoom=1.3 is set on the inner ThemedShell content <View> (class 'css-view-g5y9jx r-flex-13awgt0'), NOT on document.documentElement as the comment claims — but the visual outcome is identical (descendants scale by 1.3) and the rest of the requirements are met. Either RN-Web's style applier moved the inline zoom from html to the content view, or there's a small drift between source comment and runtime behaviour. Non-blocking — fix functionally works exactly as specified by the review.

minor.issue: Earlier test bug: requests.Session with global Content-Type: application/json header clobbered the multipart boundary, producing 422 instead of 402. Fixed by switching to bare requests.post for the multipart call. NOT a code bug — purely test infra.

integration_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter_3/iter_4 — frontend api.ts override forces production wayly.com.au backend, so background polls 401/404 leave the banner up. Not in scope for this iteration.

react_native_issues.issue: Source-level comment says 'documentElement.style.zoom' but in the running web bundle the inline zoom lands on an inner View (class css-view-g5y9jx r-flex-13awgt0) instead of <html>. Visual outcome unchanged. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ThemedShell.tsx:65-67. Non-blocking — recommend either updating the comment to match, or pinning the zoom application to <html> via root.setAttribute('style', ...) so it can't be overridden by RN-Web's reconciler.
Carry-over deprecation warning on RN-Web 0.20+ — non-blocking.
Failed to load /assets/fonts/Inter-VariableFont.ttf (server 404) — text falls back to system font. Carry-over from iter_4, not in scope.

action_items: [OPTIONAL P3] Reconcile ThemedShell.tsx comment vs runtime behaviour — the zoom CSS lands on an inner RN-Web View, not on <html>. Either tighten the implementation (document.documentElement.setAttribute('style', ...)) or update the comment so future maintainers aren't misled.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/statements.py upload_statement_text() — _record_free_tier_use(user_id) is now called at line 260 just before submit_upload_job(). Both upload paths (multipart + text) record the quota stamp consistently. Good.

ThemedShell.tsx web branch using CSS zoom (in useEffect, no key-remount) successfully preserves nav/form state across scale changes. The keyed-remount strategy is still in place on native only via key={`scale-${scale}`}. Clean Platform-aware split.

rca_of_issue: ITER_4 ROOT CAUSES were both single-line/single-strategy misses: (1) backend was missing `await _record_free_tier_use(user_id)` in upload_statement_text() — fixed by adding the call right before submit_upload_job() at routes/statements.py:260; (2) frontend was relying on Text.render monkey-patch which silently no-ops on react-native-web — fixed by adding a useEffect that sets style.zoom on the doc root and skipping the key-remount on web. Iter_5 verifies both fixes hold under real auth + UI taps.
